main_text.l: faceret. Dixi : Pergat jam quisque isto tenore, & suo marte Mathemata omnia resolvat & pandat : Quid ais Euclides bone, de extempora-libus hisce meis Mathematicis? num te pænitet jam operosæ Demonstrationis, & longæ solicitæque tuorum Effatorum ad Principia deductionis? Ridete Mathematici, & scitote hos meos Geometras-tros, & hodiernos Physicos iisdem cæpis vesci. Satis est: Amor-sapientiæ ad pronunciandam sententiam accingitur : Quid agat? exilio multet Dogmatistam? Mitior quidem ista sententia feri in Pantomimum & Mango-

page.notes: Left margin carries faint, cropped text from the facing page (fragments of a neighbouring leaf), not transcribed. The word "go-" at the foot is the catchword. Some letters in the running head and the line "Effatorū" are slightly blurred; "Mango-" in the last line is read from the hyphenated catchword and may be incomplete. The line "Dogmatistam" is read as printed.
